claim: Annual plans are refunded pro-rata within 14 days; monthly plans carry a 7-day money-back guarantee on the first payment.

claim: Annual billing saves about 17 % against twelve monthly payments.
Plan limits: Intake link = 40 reports a month, 60 startups, 3 seats; Fund = 10 seats and 500 tracked startups.
note: "5+ seats" is the FAQ's enterprise threshold (contact sales).

claim: The financial model projects 88–99.9 % gross margins on the SaaS + credit mix.
